_comment: REFERENCE ONLY. This is how Poise is built. It is not Zero-Lag project law. CLAUDE.md wins. Rewrite every poise_specific field before copying a procedure into this repo.

what_this_is: A portable dump of how Poise is built, how it is released, and what accounts, secrets, and checks a clone would need.
Keep the method. Rewrite every poise_specific field for the new app.
This is not legal advice and not a substitute for CLAUDE.md in the live Poise repo.
Do not paste this file into Yination01/Poise. Poise already has the live copy of its law.

companion_files.note: The pack is standing AI law. This file is product architecture plus ops. A new app usually wants both.

product.name: Poise
product.one_line: Android app that drafts replies to chat notifications. The user approves every send.
product.brand_place: Nigeria, never Built in Lagos, except a deliberate jurisdiction clause
product.support_email_note: Support and sender address. Not a GitHub account. Do not commit as this address.
product.legacy_host_rule: 307-redirects to the live host and must stay.
product.dead_host: getpoise.vercel.app does not exist. poise.app is an unrelated macOS app.
product.ios: Present in the repo, not shipped.

play.decision: Free tier only on Play under the reader-app carve-out. Paid stays on the direct APK.
play.status: Not implemented. No Play Console account yet. Screenshots and demo video still missing.

client.apk_job_node_why: eas-cli 23 refuses Node 20. CI ci.yml is still Node 20.

backend.cap_rule: Adding a thirteenth function breaks the deploy. New endpoints fold into an existing file.
backend.firebase_admin: pinned 11.11.1. Do not bump to v14. v14 500ed production.
backend.backend_engines: 24.x (sandbox may be 20.x; the suite still runs)
backend.mail: Google Apps Script, not Resend. Resend is a leftover dependency.
backend.ai: Groq primary. Optional OpenAI-compatible backup. Voice is Groq Whisper. HF_API_KEY is dead.

native_android.never: Never edit android/ by hand. Never bump versionCode on push. expo prebuild mutates package.json; diff it afterwards.

stack.budget: Zero. No paid tiers, no domain purchases, no Blaze plan. Propose the free alternative.

accounts_the_app_needs.what: Private repo, Actions enabled, contents:write on the APK job
accounts_the_app_needs.owner: A real GitHub user. Vercel Hobby blocks commits it cannot attribute.

accounts_the_app_needs.what: Expo account, EAS project, access token named EXPO_TOKEN in GitHub Actions secrets
Auth (email/password, Google, email-link), Firestore, Android app with google-services.json
console_must: Release SHA-1 on the Android OAuth client or Google sign-in breaks
Password reset still uses Firebase mail

accounts_the_app_needs.what: Hobby project, Git integration on main, Root Directory = backend/
API key starting gsk_. This is the only required AI key.
Live keys if you take cards in Nigeria. Webhook URL on the live host /api/paystack.
accounts_the_app_needs.vip_why_2400: Paystack waives the flat NGN 100 fee under 2500.

accounts_the_app_needs.what: Mail transport. GAS_MAIL_URL + GAS_MAIL_TOKEN. Sender is a real inbox you own.
Web client id in the app (identifier, not a secret). Native Google still needs the release SHA-1.

secrets.rule: No secrets client-side. Never write a secret into a file, a commit, or .git/config. Push via GIT_ASKPASS.
client_identifiers_ok_in_app_json: Firebase web apiKey (identifier, not a credential)

github_actions_secrets.name: EXPO_TOKEN
github_actions_secrets.required_for: apk.yml. Job fails fast if missing.

github_actions_secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
github_actions_secrets.required_for: optional. ci.yml skips manual Vercel deploy if absent. Git integration already deploys.

never: A live payment key in chat or the repo
A GitHub PAT in the remote URL or .git/config

layers.name: App.js
layers.does: Auth restore, remote-config load, maintenance gate, AppState listeners, mode scheduler effect, RootNavigator. Launch starts here.

layers.name: screens
layers.does: UI only. Do not fetch Firebase from a screen.

layers.name: services
layers.does: The layer between screens and the outside world.

layers.name: backend/api
layers.does: All authorisation. There is no deployed firestore.rules. firestore.rules.js is a .js file, not rules.

layers.name: plugins/native
layers.does: Android notification listener, overlay, scheduler FGS, Quick Settings tile, DND, broadcast receiver.

src/screens/auth: LoginScreen (password, Google, email-link). Welcome Get started opens signup mode.
src/screens/main: HomeScreen (inbox and draft cards: the product)
client_tree.root_gate: MaintenanceScreen when the server says maintenance or build is below minBuild
client_tree.src/store: appStore.js. updateSettings takes a patch object, not a full state. showToast is the only toast entry point.

backend_functions_12.does: Sign-in wall, isSuper, then blanket 403. lookup, user_list, user_hide, tester_create, beta_revoke, app_config, promo, notices, waitlist, paystack_init.
Drafting. Tier gates for style, custom vibes, styleHint. Called over the network, not in the APK.
Checkout webhook. HMAC-SHA512 of raw body, then re-verify, then grant. Init is in admin.js.
Account sync, settings up and down. Writes users/{uid}/sync/state.
Signup, confirm, purge, username lookup (folded in to stay under the cap). Also serves the public page.
Email sign-in links through Apps Script. The app redeems the link, not the browser.

backend_utils.does: Single source of grant maths. Same tier extends. Lower under a live higher pauses. Higher over lower pushes the lower clock out. Never reimplement inline.
Beta and tester identity. Every gate fails closed.
Rate limit per endpoint per 60 seconds. Catch path fails open deliberately.
Apps Script transport and HTML newsletter shell.
Model routing. Ids overridable by env.
Prompt assembly. Keep client and server copies aligned.
Offline canned replies when AI is down.
Normalisation, shared by claim and lookup.
Hide-from-list prefers body.uid. Unique Auth displayName fallback. 409 if two match. Never deletes.

services.does: Reads notifications. EXTRA_TEXT then MessagingStyle EXTRA_MESSAGES. Journals then emits to JS. Empty text is dropped before JS.

Foreground service. Prefs key poise_scheduler. Keeps the process for mode ticks. Does not draft. JS is suspended when the activity leaves the foreground. Ready to draft in the shade is this service, not the writer.
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW popup. Title is Poise draft.
Accessibility service. Class name is a leftover, not the product name.

native.receiver: ModeCommandReceiver.kt ACTION_SET_MODE EXTRA_MODE_ID for automation apps.

collections_and_docs: users/{uid}/sync/state (modes live on device in mockFirestore, sync ships them here, not users/{uid}/modes)
testers/{uid} (pin. Absent means not a tester.)
config/appConfig (kill switch, minBuild, latestBuild, paymentsLive, downloadUrl)

remote_config_flags.paymentsLive: Must be boolean true or the Pay button is hidden.
remote_config_flags.downloadUrl: Keyed https URL. Empty means no Get it button. Must be https.

plans.unlimited_why: Do not use Infinity. JSON.stringify(Infinity) is null and used < null is false.
plans.legacy_vip: VIP grants started before 2026-08-19 keep the old higher limits until they expire.
plans.recurring: None. One charge grants days. The plan ends on that date.

launch: Onboarding if notification access is missing
subscribeNotifications + drainCaptureJournal on start and on foreground
draft: If title is WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business, sender is lastMessagingStyleSender, not the app name
Native journals, then emits to JS
draftGuard: skip OTP, skip automated senders (apple, meta). whatsapp is NOT an automated sender name as of build 39
If skip, Activity shows the reason. No draft.
incomingMessage builds the request including activeMode.auto_message
aiService POST /api/draft-reply, or fallbackEngine if offline / AI down
Home shows DraftCard labelled AI draft. User approves every send.
auto_send: replySender needs a live notificationKey and RemoteInput
If the WhatsApp notification is gone, auto-send cannot fire
Foreground JS sleep: when the activity is gone, JS does not draft. FGS keepAlive does not run the writer.
pay: Client calls admin.js paystack_init. Server names the amount.
Webhook POST /api/paystack, HMAC-SHA512 of raw body
Do not send NGN 100 as a live test. Test cards do not work on live keys.
Admin accounts are forced Premium. Test with Control As Free (8 hours) or a second Free real-email account.

identity.blocked_author_example: Yination <admin.poise@gmail.com> produced five Vercel Hobby deploys marked Blocked, GitHub user not found.

ci.yml.name: SilentMode CI/CD
ci.yml.build_android_job: Skips unless android/gradlew exists. Expo managed: the real APK is apk.yml.
ci.yml.deploy_backend_job: Optional Vercel action. Git integration already deploys.

apk.yml.name: Preview APK
apk.yml.trigger: workflow_dispatch only. Input build_number, digits only.
steps_in_order: setup-node 22 with npm cache on both lockfiles
validate build_number: digits, strip leading zeros, N >= 11, tag preview-N must not exist
npm ci --prefix backend || npm install --prefix backend
stamp app.json extra.buildNumber = BUILD_N (AFTER audits, never commit that stamp)
npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview --local --non-interactive --output poise.apk
softprops/action-gh-release prerelease tag preview-N files poise.apk
apk.yml.stamp_ordering_scar: Stamping before audits made build 21 fail because fixes.cjs asserts in-repo buildNumber is still dev.
apk.yml.eas_profile: eas.json build.preview, android.buildType apk, distribution internal
apk.yml.does_not_use: EAS cloud quota. Local EAS on the GitHub Ubuntu runner.
apk.yml.install_path_for_testers: https://LIVE_HOST/download?key=DOWNLOAD_KEY. Never send the private GitHub release URL.

apk_dispatch_ritual.hard_rule: Never start an APK / EAS / Actions build unless the build number appears in the user's own message this turn. Start the next build authorises exactly one, the next one, once.
apk_dispatch_ritual.when_work_is_ready_and_no_number: Say: the work is on main, the suite is green, name the build number and I will dispatch. Then wait.
steps: Confirm the number is in the user's own message this turn.
Exactly one changelog entry in src/config/changelog.js with build: N. audience may be all, testers, beta, or admin. Admin notes do not go in Notices.
Commit as Yination01 <johnpaulonovo@gmail.com>. Push via GIT_ASKPASS. Do not bump Android versionCode.
Confirm tag preview-N does not already exist (404).
POST workflow_dispatch apk.yml with build_number=N. Expect HTTP 204.
At dispatch, write .build-state.json lastBuild { number, commit (the cut SHA), dispatchedAt, runId, tag }.
Watch the run to success. Tag preview-N. Asset poise.apk uploaded.
Docs-only record and SITEMAP map commits after, they are not on the APK.

changelog_contract.admin: Renders on Admin, Control, Admin notes. canSeeNotice(admin) is false for every Notices reader.
changelog_contract.no_SilentMode_in_user_facing_src: suite.cjs scans src/*.js. Do not write SilentMode in changelog copy.

apk_dispatch_ritual.mirror_rule: Work that lands after a build is not on anyone's phone. Say so, and say whether it changes the APK or only the docs. npm run test:all prints the pending list from .build-state.json.

every_turn: Read AGENTS.md then CLAUDE.md before editing. CLAUDE.md wins ties.
Recreate git user.name and user.email. Re-add origin if missing.
Be concise. Use the domain's words.
If unsure, ask. Questionnaire with discrete options. Every question has RECOMMENDED plus reasoning.
Failing check first, then the fix.
Mutation-test every new check. Restore from a copied backup, never git checkout, then diff.
Assert the guarantee, not one spelling of a string.
No done claim without a fresh full test command and an explicit unverified list.
No em-dash (U+2014) and no en-dash (U+2013) in code, copy, comments, docs, or agent replies about the product.
Double-check search-replace actually landed. It has dropped JSX bodies, and has written literal \n into JS string concatenations.
Parallel edits to the same file overwrite each other.
new_feature: Skills: brainstorming, then writing-plans, then test-driven-development, then implement.
Confirm the approach. Do not guess a product decision onto main.
phone_bug: A bug report is about the build on that device, not HEAD.
Root cause, add or extend an audit, ship, commit, push.
Say whether the fix is on anyone's phone.

testing.before: Snapshots drop node_modules. npm install and npm install --prefix backend first.
testing.bar: A passing test proves nothing until a mutant kills it.

security: Every public endpoint gets a rate limit.
Never interpolate a value into innerHTML. textContent or DOM nodes.
safeError to clients. Log the stack server-side.
Verify webhook signatures before trusting any payment event.
ui: DESIGN.md and src/config/constants.js scales. No hardcoded hex in screens.
Red is a budget: destruction and warnings only.
Four states on every screen: loading, empty, error, success.
Async buttons disable for the round-trip. Irreversible actions never optimistic.
WCAG 2.1 AA. 44 pt minimum. accessibilityRole on Pressable. State never by colour alone.
No emoji as feature icons. No AI-default purple.

beta_and_testers.rule: Beta is admin-granted only. Tester is identity, not entitlement. Badge carries no tier.
beta_and_testers.fail_closed: Missing config/beta means shut. Firestore read error means shut. Only enrolmentOpen === true opens it. Same for testers/{uid}.
beta_and_testers.general_form: A rule that lives only in conversation memory is not enforced and will be violated. Write it down the same day, with a check.

git_push: Commit and push when a fix pass is done.
Do not bump Android versionCode on push.
Never write a token into the repo, a commit, or .git/config.

priority: 4 .agent/quality-bar.json (v40.0, 181 items). stack_exclusions are not open work.
agent_law_short.on_request_how: When the trigger fits, recommend it in the questionnaire with reasoning and wait for yes. Do not invoke silently. Do not wait for the user to name the skill.
hard_rules_one_line: No APK/EAS/Actions build unless the build number is in the user's own message this turn.
Questionnaire with discrete options. Every question has RECOMMENDED plus reasoning. If unsure, ask.
Failing check first, then the fix.
Mutation-test every new check. Restore from a copied backup, never git checkout, then diff.
Assert the guarantee, not one spelling of a string.
No done claim without a fresh full test command and an explicit unverified list.
Copy fixed values exactly: commit identity, Nigeria not Lagos, Admin not superuser, no em-dash or en-dash.
Beta is admin-granted only. Fail closed. A rule only in chat will be violated; write it down the same day.

keep_the_method: Eight hard rules, generalised (release named this turn, questionnaire, test first, mutants, assert the guarantee, verify before done, copy fixed values, write decisions down).
Thin stubs in every agent runtime pointing at AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
A check that the rules stay stated.
workflow_dispatch APK job that stamps AFTER the suite, tags preview-N, refuses a reused tag.
Vercel root = backend/, function folding under the Hobby cap.
Server-side authorisation. Rate limits. Schema validation. Webhook HMAC.
Semantic colour scales. No hardcoded hex in screens.
Git identity that Vercel can attribute.
rewrite_for_the_new_product: Name, package, scheme, live host, support inbox
Native plugins (Poise's notification listener is the product, not a template you drop in blindly)
Beta/tester gates if the new product has no such badge
Paystack amounts and Nigeria brand line unless it is also Nigeria-first
firebase-admin pin, only if you hit the same scar
applies_to_poise flags: retag as applies_to_project for the new stack

new_app_bootstrap_checklist: Create the GitHub repo. Owner must be a real GitHub user.
Set git user.name and user.email to that GitHub account, not a support inbox.
Expo account + EXPO_TOKEN in Actions secrets.
Firebase project: Auth, Firestore, Android app, google-services.json, authorised domain = live host, SHA-1 for Google sign-in.
Vercel project, Root Directory backend/, env vars from secrets.vercel_env (values only in Vercel).
Groq key. Confirm current model ids on the deprecations page.
If cards: Paystack live keys, webhook https://LIVE/api/paystack, amounts from server only.
If mail: Apps Script web app + token. A real From inbox.
Copy agent-pack.json, skills.json, quality-bar.json into .agent/. Retag skills. Fill stack_exclusions.
Write CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Thin stubs. agent-docs and agent-rules checks. Do not start feature work until those pass.
eas.json preview profile, apk.yml on workflow_dispatch, ci.yml running the full suite including backend install.
env.example.txt with names and no values.
DESIGN.md once tokens exist. SITEMAP.md from day one.
Do not dispatch a numbered build until the user names the number in that turn.
